content: De Two People wa da Tell God Message
Atta dat, dey gii me one stick like wa dey nyuse fa tek fa medja. Den dey tell me say, “Mus go medja God House an de alta dey. An mus count de people dem wa da woshup God dey eenside e House.
Bot mus dohn medja de open place wa dey roun God House, cause dat place dey fa dem wa ain God own people. An dem people gwine mash God city onda dey foot fa foty-two mont.
A gwine sen two people wa gwine tell de people bout me. A gwine gim powa. Dey gwine weah buryin cloes. An dey gwine tell people God message fa one tousan, two hundud sixty day.”
De two people dem wa gwine tell God message, dey de two olib tree an de two lamp stan dem wa da stanop fo de Lawd wa da rule oba all de wol.
Ef poson try fa do dem two people yah bad, fire gwine come outta dey mout an bun de poson an stroy um. So den, dat how de poson wa try fa do dem two bad gwine dead.

Dem two people got powa fa hole back de rain een de sky, so dat de rain ain faddown jurin de time wen dey da tell God message. An dey got powa fa mek de wata wa come outta de groun ton eenta blood. An dey got powa fa sen wasoneba kind ob bad ting eenta de wol, wasoneba time dey wahn fa do um.
Now den, wen dey done tell de people dey message, de wile beast wa come op outta de deep hole wa ain got no bottom, e gwine come an fight dem. E gwine win out oba um an kill um.
Dey dead body gwine leddown een de screet een de big city weh de people been nail dey Lawd ta de cross. Dey call dat city Sodom or Egypt, wa mean fa say dat city jes like dem.

All kind ob people wa come out fom all de tribe an all de nation een de wol, people wa taak all de diffunt language, dey gwine tek shree an a haf day, da pass by an look pon de dead body ob de two people wa done tell God message. An jurin dat time dey ain gwine leh nobody tek dem dead body an bury um.
De people een de wol gwine rejaice wen dem two prophet yah dead. Dey gwine mek merry an gii one noda gif, cause dem two prophet yah done beena mek um suffa tommuch.
Bot atta shree an a haf day done pass, God blow life eenta de two prophet dem, an dey stanop. All de people wa see dem two, dey scaid fa true.

Den de two prophet dem yeh loud boice wa come outta heaben da tell um say, “Oona come op yah!” An wiles de people wa been ginst um stanop da look at um, de two prophet dem gone op eenta heaben eenside one cloud.

Jes den, de groun tremble too bad. One ob ebry ten buildin een de city been stroy, an seben tousan people done dead. De oda people wa ain dead, dey scaid down, an dey praise God, wa da rule een heaben.
De secon haad time wen people suffa plenty, done pass oba. Bot look yah! De haad time wa mek shree da come soon.
De Angel wa Mek Seben Blow E Trumpet

Den de angel wa mek seben blow e trumpet. An A yeh plenty boice een heaben da taak loud say, “We Lawd an e Messiah Christ, dey got de powa an dey da rule now oba de wol. An e gwine rule faeba an eba!”
Den de twenty-fo elda, dem big leada wa da seddown pon dey shrone een front ob God, dey git down wid dey face ta de groun fo God an dey woshup um.
Dey say:

content.text: “Lawd God wa got powa mo den all,
wa been dey faeba, an wa still dey now!
cause ya done nyuse ya powa wa mo den all,
an staat fa rule oba de wol!
De people wa ain ya own,
dey been mad op fa true,
bot de time done come fa ya fa show dat ya too bex wid dem.
De time done come wen ya gwine jedge dem wa done dead.
Dis de time fa gii all dem people wa da saab ya dey payback,
de prophet dem, an all dem wa blongst ta ya,
an dem wa gii ya hona, dem wa got powa,
an dem wa ain got no powa.
An de time done come fa stroy dem wa stroy people een de wol!”

content: Den God House een heaben open op, an dey een e House, A see de box weh dey pit de ting weh dey write de cobnant. Dat de greement wa God mek wid all people. Den lightnin staat fa flash, an a big nise staat op, an tunda staat fa soun. De groun staat fa tremble an a heapa hail staat fa faddown.
